sn45.11:1.3: namhi kenaci upasaṅkamitabbo, aññatra ekena piṇḍapātanīhārakenāti.
sn45.11:1.4: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paṭissutvā nāssudha koci bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamati, aññatra ekena piṇḍapātanīhārakena.
sn45.11:2.1: atha kho bhagavā tassa aḍḍhamāsassa accayena paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito bhikkhū āmantesi.
sn45.11:2.2: yena svāhaṃ bhikkhave, vihārena paṭhamābhisambuddho viharāmi, tassa padesena vihāsiṃ.
sn45.11:2.5: sammādiṭṭhipaccayāpi vedayitaṃ, micchāsaṅakappapaccayāpi vedayitaṃ, sammāsaṅakappapaccayāpi vedayitaṃ, micchāvācāpaccayāpi vedayitaṃ, sammāvācāpaccayāpi vedayitaṃ, micchākammantapaccayāpi vedayitaṃ, sammākammantapaccayāpi vedayitaṃ, micchāājīvapaccayāpi vedayitaṃ, sammāājīvapaccayāpi vedayitaṃ, micchāvāyāmapaccayāpi vedayitaṃ, sammāvāyāmapaccayāpi vedayitaṃ, micchāsatipaccayāpi vedayitaṃ, sammāsatipaccayāpi vedayitaṃ,
sn45.11:2.11: chando ca avupasanto hoti, vitakkā ca avupasantā honti, saññā ca avupasantā honti, tappaccayāpi vedayitaṃ,
sn45.11:2.12: (chando ca vūpasanto hoti, vitakkā ca avupasantā honti, saññā ca avupasantā honti, tappaccayāpi vedayitaṃ, chando ca vūpasanto hoti, vitakkā ca vūpasantā honti, saññā ca avupasantā honti, tappaccayāpi vedayitaṃ.) chando ca vūpasanto hoti, vitakkā ca vūpasantā honti, saññā ca vūpasantā honti, tappaccayāpi vedayitaṃ,
